tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub chen gyi gdangs dbyangs gtong tshul la/ thog mar nyin dang po brgya rdung chen mo/ bla ma rnams kyi= gdangs chen/ nga ni ye nas= rgyun chags/ rtsa gdangs rgyun chags/ snang ba snod kyi= gdangs chen/ gsol ka nang la/ khrag mtsho lcags kyi= gdangs chen/ 'khrugs skong la/ ma mo 'khrugs pa'i rgyu bstan= gdangs chen/ legs ldan/ 'dod pa'i yon tan= gdangs chen/ rtsi dmar/ phyogs phyogs= gdangs chen/ ༈ nyin gnyis pa la/ chos sku mi 'gyur= gdangs chen/ rdo rje slob dpon= gdangs chen/ gsol ka g.yas su sbyor ba'i ging chen= gdangs chen/ khyad par ma mo= gdangs chen/ mnyam med mthu mnga'= gdangs chen/ ༈ nyin gsum pa la/ sngon gyi bskal pa= gdangs chen/ dur khrod gsang ba= gdangs chen/ gsol ka g.yon du sgrol ba'i= gdangs chen/ yang gcig ma mo 'khrugs pa'i= gdangs chen/ dur khrod rab 'jigs= gdangs chen/ ༈ nyin bzhi pa la/ bde chen 'bar ba= gdangs chen/ ma bcos spros bral= gdangs chen/ gsol ka la/ ting 'dzin sprul 354)pa'i= gdangs chen/ dpal ldan rang byung= gdangs chen/ rang snang 'od gsal= gdangs chen/ ༈ nyin lnga pa la/ phyi mchod gdangs chen/ rta yi brtul zhugs= gdangs chen/ snang srid kun gyi phywa chen= gdangs chen/ skye med rdo rje= gdangs chen/ g.yang 'gugs gdangs chen/ ༈ nyin drug pa la/ sman mchod gdangs chen/ gsol ka la/ rdo rje phag mo dbyings kyi= gdangs chen/ sum cu rtsa gsum= gdangs chen/ rig 'dzin padma thod phreng= gdangs chen/ ༈ nyin bdun pa la/ rje btsun bla ma= gdangs chen/ 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i= gdangs chen/ dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i= gdangs chen/ lha mo/ phyogs phyogs de ni= gdangs chen/ ༈ nyin brgyad pa la/ gtor 'bul gdangs chen no// dge'o//
